name: CLOSEFIL.jcl
description:
This JCL job closes five specific CICS files in the CICSAWSA region by issuing CEMT SET FILE CLOSE commands through SDSF, ensuring that the files are no longer accessible for transaction processing. This is typically performed during maintenance windows or controlled shutdown procedures to safely quiesce file activity in the CICS environment.Key Functionalities:
Closes the TRANSACT file in the CICSAWSA CICS region, making it unavailable for transaction data processing.
Closes the CCXREF file in the CICSAWSA CICS region, making it unavailable for cross-reference data lookups.
Closes the ACCTDAT file in the CICSAWSA CICS region, making it unavailable for account data access.
Closes the CXACAIX file in the CICSAWSA CICS region, making it unavailable for alternate index access on account cross-reference data.
Closes the USRSEC file in the CICSAWSA CICS region, making it unavailable for user security data processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICSAWSA CICS region is active and the TRANSACT file is currently open and available to online users
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The batch job CLOSEFIL is submitted and the CLCIFIL step executes
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The TRANSACT file in the CICSAWSA CICS region must be set to CLOSED status, making it inaccessible to online transactions

rules.Rule_Name: CLCIFIL - SDSF - Close TRANSACT File in CICS Region
rules.Rule_Description: When the batch job is initiated, the TRANSACT file in the CICSAWSA CICS region must be closed to prevent online transactions from accessing or modifying transaction data during batch processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICSAWSA CICS region is active and the CCXREF cross-reference file is currently open and available to online users
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The TRANSACT file closure command has been issued and the CLCIFIL step continues execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The CCXREF file in the CICSAWSA CICS region must be set to CLOSED status, making it inaccessible to online transactions

rules.Rule_Name: CLCIFIL - SDSF - Close CCXREF File in CICS Region
rules.Rule_Description: When the batch job is initiated, the CCXREF cross-reference file in the CICSAWSA CICS region must be closed to prevent online transactions from accessing cross-reference data during batch processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICSAWSA CICS region is active and the ACCTDAT account data file is currently open and available to online users
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CCXREF file closure command has been issued and the CLCIFIL step continues execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The ACCTDAT file in the CICSAWSA CICS region must be set to CLOSED status, making it inaccessible to online transactions

rules.Rule_Name: CLCIFIL - SDSF - Close ACCTDAT File in CICS Region
rules.Rule_Description: When the batch job is initiated, the ACCTDAT account data file in the CICSAWSA CICS region must be closed to prevent online transactions from accessing or modifying account data during batch processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICSAWSA CICS region is active and the CXACAIX account cross-reference alternate index file is currently open and available to online users
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The ACCTDAT file closure command has been issued and the CLCIFIL step continues execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The CXACAIX file in the CICSAWSA CICS region must be set to CLOSED status, making alternate-key account lookups inaccessible to online transactions

rules.Rule_Name: CLCIFIL - SDSF - Close CXACAIX File in CICS Region
rules.Rule_Description: When the batch job is initiated, the CXACAIX account cross-reference alternate index file in the CICSAWSA CICS region must be closed to prevent online transactions from performing alternate-key account lookups during batch processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICSAWSA CICS region is active and the USRSEC user security file is currently open and available to online users
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CXACAIX file closure command has been issued and the CLCIFIL step continues execution
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: The USRSEC file in the CICSAWSA CICS region must be set to CLOSED status, making user security profile data inaccessible to online transactions

rules.Rule_Name: CLCIFIL - SDSF - Close USRSEC File in CICS Region
rules.Rule_Description: When the batch job is initiated, the USRSEC user security file in the CICSAWSA CICS region must be closed to prevent online transactions from accessing or modifying user security profiles during batch processing.

Acceptance_Criteria.Given: The CICSAWSA CICS region is active with all five files (TRANSACT, CCXREF, ACCTDAT, CXACAIX, USRSEC) open and serving online users
Acceptance_Criteria.When: The CLOSEFIL batch job is submitted to initiate the batch processing window
Acceptance_Criteria.Then: All five files must be closed sequentially in the following fixed order: (1) TRANSACT, (2) CCXREF, (3) ACCTDAT, (4) CXACAIX, (5) USRSEC — with no conditions, no skips, and no alternate paths — ensuring the CICSAWSA region is fully quiesced and no online transaction can access any of these files before batch processing begins

rules.Rule_Name: CLCIFIL - SDSF - Sequential Closure of All CICS Business Files Before Batch Processing
rules.Rule_Description: All five CICS-managed business files must be closed in a strict sequential order — TRANSACT, CCXREF, ACCTDAT, CXACAIX, and USRSEC — to fully quiesce the CICSAWSA region before any batch update jobs are allowed to run. No file is skipped and there are no conditional branches.
